title: Report how big refs/foam/data has grown
body:
Every write is a commit on refs/foam/data and the chain goes back to init, so the ref only grows, and today nothing shows by how much. A person who wants to know whether foam is bloating the repository has to hand-roll rev-list and cat-file.

Add a report, either as foam stats or as lines in foam doctor:

- commits on the ref, and when the chain started
- objects reachable from the ref and their size on disk (git rev-list --objects refs/foam/data | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objectsize:disk)'), split into what only the ref holds versus what the branches share
- issue and memory counts, and the largest records
- with --json, the same numbers for scripts

Compaction (squashing old history) is a separate decision and not part of this; the report is what would tell us whether it is ever needed.
close_reason: foam stats: commits and age, objects only the ref holds on disk, the tip's files, the largest records; --json; integration test
